verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents transfer-in through both the web flow and the API. The web flow supports bulk submission of up to 500 domains and a 'pause my transfer' option so DNS can be set up before the transfer goes to the registry. Signed webhooks cover transfer events for status tracking, and there is a GoDaddy migration guide. However, the evidence never spells out the EPP/auth-code steps, what a transfer costs, or what happens to remaining registration time, so the 'honest about costs and time' part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit EPP/auth-code flow documentation, transfer pricing disclosure, remaining-registration-time policy, independent hands-on transfer reports.
